highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.0 previews Skia m155 with updated HarfBuzz and GLES interop.
highlights_body: It disables RAW and DNG decoding, updates HarfBuzz to 14.4.0, and incorporates current m155 renderer fixes.

breaking.title: RAW and DNG decoding disabled
breaking.body: The bundled codec no longer decodes RAW or DNG images. Decode these formats with a dedicated library and provide a supported raster image to SkiaSharp instead.

bullets.detail: The bundled renderer moves to Chrome milestone 155 and includes the latest upstream bug-fix sync.
GLES interop signatures use pointer-based forms for direct native interoperation.
Updates the bundled HarfBuzz engine and its corresponding HarfBuzzSharp release.

preview_summaries.v4.155.0-preview.1.26471.14: Preview 1 opened the m155 line with the Skia milestone update.
preview_summaries.v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13: Preview 2 added the HarfBuzz 14.4.0 update, pointer-based GLES interop, m155 bug fixes, and disabled RAW and DNG decoding.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates the bundled HarfBuzz engine and HarfBuzzSharp release to version 14.4.0.

v4.155.0-preview.1.26471.14.headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m155 engine update.

v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13.headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.0 Preview 2 updates HarfBuzz and GLES interop.
v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13.body: It also incorporates current m155 renderer fixes and disables RAW and DNG decoding.
